en_US: Hey, kid! Don’t you love the sun?
It’s so bright, hot and elegant!
Don’t you agree?
Hey, kid! Don’t you love the moon?
It’s so magical, cold and beautiful!
Don’t you agree?
Come back again tomorrow!
I’ll tell you more about the wonders
we see above us!
I like your style! Let me share an
item with you that represents what
the sun stands for!
I like your style! Let me share an
item with you that represents what
the moon stands for!
Eh? You don’t agree?
You don’t appreciate astronomy, kid!
My brother’s always been interested
in astronomy. It’s all he talks about.
That said, he has so much trouble
getting people to listen to him...
The Sun Stone and Moon Stone
are such cool items!
The Moon Stone evolved our Clefairy!
